Class OperationStatus

java.lang.Object
org.roux.model.OperationStatus
public final class OperationStatus extends Object
The OperationStatus type holds the integer codes a changing call can return. The SUCCESS code is 0. The BLOCKED_BY_PIN code is 1. The RESOURCE_BUSY code is 2. The CORRUPTED_SEGMENT code is 3. The LOCK_TIMEOUT code is 4. The STALE_VIEW code is 5. The UNSUPPORTED code is 6. The NOT_FOUND code is 7. A caller reads the code from an OperationResult. The type refuses construction. // @aa-sdd L40 aa-sdd-source-prose.md#OperationStatus roux-design.md
